name: fuel-pos
description: ระบบ POS ปั๊มน้ำมัน ควบคุมตู้จ่ายผ่าน RS-485/RS-422 (cross-platform, เน้น Windows)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @fuel-pos/shared && npm run build -w @fuel-pos/pump-core && npm run build -w @fuel-pos/server && npm run build -w @fuel-pos/pos-ui
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,ui -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @fuel-pos/server" "npm run dev -w @fuel-pos/pos-ui"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @fuel-pos/pump-core && npm run test -w @fuel-pos/server
scripts.pack:win: npm run build && npm --prefix apps/desktop install && npm --prefix apps/desktop run dist:win
